services.name: sunset cruise
services.desc: Come take a cruise on Lake Tahoe with our Tritoon cruiser! Loaded up with sound, shade, and good times. Take a custom tour of Emerald Bay, Rubicon Cliffs, bar hop or just relax. Good for family, friends, Bachelor/Bachelorette trips. Your are in charge! Pick your captain at the office and tell them what you want to see or just simply ask about the best spots around the lake. We take 2, 4, 6, and 8 hour trips starting from the Tahoe Keys Marina in South Lake Tahoe, CA. Starts times vary. Take the 4th of July Fireworks Show tour, where we take you to watch the fireworks up close and personal! Tours start at 8:30pm. services.name: Party Pontoon
services.desc: Our luxurious 25-foot pontoon is one of the largest and most rented boats on Lake Tahoe. Whether you’re planning a birthday, bachelor/bachelorette party, family reunion, or corporate outing - the Party Pontoon delivers a wide, stable, feature-packed platform for up to 12 guests. This boat has so much room, you can pack all your friends or family in it along with your gear and still have space to walk around freely. It’s the ultimate Party Boat South Lake Tahoe experience for those who value comfort, flexibility, and fun on the water. services.name: wake surfing
services.desc: Few experiences compare to the rush of Lake Tahoe wake surfing-riding endless waves framed by snow-capped mountains and shimmering blue waters. Whether you’re just starting or have years of experience, wake surfing in Lake Tahoe delivers thrills unlike anywhere else. The combination of crisp alpine air, clear water, and modern surf boats creates an unforgettable setting for riders at every level. In this guide, we’ll break down essential tips for beginners, advanced techniques for seasoned surfers, and advice on making the most of your time on the lake. services.name: private boat charter
services.desc: Both promise unforgettable views and endless fun, but the experience can vary dramatically. In this guide, we’ll explore what sets these two options apart and why Discover Tahoe Cruises in South Lake Tahoe is your go-to choice for both private charters and rentals. Before diving into which option is better for your group, let’s clarify the main difference between private boat charters and Lake Tahoe boat rentals. A private boat charter typically includes a dedicated captain and crew, allowing you to sit back, relax, and fully enjoy the experience. services.name: Boat Rental:
services.desc: A private boat cruise transforms your birthday into an experience rather than an event. You’re not confined to four walls or limited by time slots. Instead, you enjoy open water, panoramic mountain views, and a celebration that flows at your pace. Many guests say their favorite part is the freedom. You can anchor in a quiet cove, jump in for a swim, enjoy drinks with friends, or simply cruise along the shoreline while taking photos. Every cruise feels personal and exclusive, making it an ideal choice for milestone birthdays and unforgettable celebrations. quotes.author: Heydy Torrez
quotes.text: I recently had the pleasure of embarking on a boat charter with captain Ariel and I can confidently say that it was an unforgettable experience! From beautiful sightseeing Emerald Bay to tubing across the lake. I highly recommend Discover Tahoe Chartered Cruises for your next adventure.

quotes.author: Joan Morse
quotes.text: Mac was so informative and awesome! He made the trip so fun! He showed us some amazing beaches and their history. Mac recommended great restaurants and gave a lot of history to Lake Tahoe. It was a great experience! One for the books for sure! Thank you!!
